file_inventory.purpose: Application entry point; creates the FastAPI app, wires middleware, routers, static files, and startup DB init
Authentication helpers: password hashing, JWT creation/decoding, current-user dependency
Package marker for the app module
Application settings (secret key, JWT algorithm, token expiry, database URL) sourced from environment variables with defaults
Teaching cost table and formula for estimating cost in USD from model name and token counts
SQLAlchemy engine/session setup and DB session dependency and initialization
SQLAlchemy ORM models for users, projects, and session logs
Analytics endpoint returning per-model and total session/token/cost summaries for the current user
Auth routes: user registration, login (issuing access/refresh tokens), and current-user lookup
CRUD-style routes for creating, listing, and retrieving projects owned by the current user
Routes for creating and listing Claude Code session logs tied to a project, computing cost via app.costing

authentication_system: JWT-based auth using python-jose for token encode/decode and passlib/bcrypt for password hashing. Access tokens (60 min expiry) and refresh tokens (7 day expiry, with a jti claim) are issued on login via /auth/login. get_current_user in auth.py decodes the access token, validates its type and subject, and loads the active user from the database as a FastAPI dependency used across protected routes.
database_layer: SQLAlchemy ORM over SQLite (configurable via TRACKER_DATABASE_URL). Models: User, Project, SessionLog, defined in app/models.py with relationships between them. app/database.py provides the engine, session factory, a get_db dependency generator, and init_db() to create tables on startup.
external_integrations: None (no external API calls or third-party service integrations found in app/); static frontend files served locally via StaticFiles
